name: 2nd-Order Finite Difference Gradient
aliases: 2nd-Order Finite Difference Gradient — Central Difference Gradient Estimation, ISGradient<CD_2ND>, NormalGenerator
definition: Computes surface normals for grid coordinates using a second-order central difference gradient (ISGradient<CD_2ND>).
summary: The 2nd-Order Finite Difference Gradient estimates volume normals via central differences, distinguished by its simpler, lower-accuracy stencil that requires fewer memory accesses but is more susceptible to directional bias.
